method: Native mesh UV, perspective-correct barycentric interpolation, nearest-depth rasterization
background: Linear extension toward image borders; eye openings interpolated; rows outside head use nearest covered row.
source: Final registered scene / original head UV with eye depth occlusion
eyeHandling: Visible eyeballs occlude the head interior; interpolate native U across each opening from the eyelid boundary.
interaction: Mask native U >= slider threshold; U=0.5 is midline. No screen-space translation.
